decisions.reason: The stainless-steel whisk material is already represented by a complete same-message MODIFY in this Requirement; no additional update or removal is needed.
Selecting the stainless-steel whisk does not change the existing smoothness, consistency, or frothiness acceptance criteria.
The whisk selection does not alter the splash-control target or conditional mitigation measures.
The selected whisk is compatible context for the 4.5-quart bowl but does not change the bowl's capacity, depth, or refill policy.
The whisk-head decision does not modify the spout's appearance, material, fabrication method, or prototype scope.
The whisk selection does not necessarily change the enclosure size or side-profile constraints.
The component-level whisk selection leaves the DJ-turntable visual theme unchanged.
The word 'Whisk' in the brand name is incidental; the selected whisk design does not change the placard text, position, or orientation.
The stainless-steel whisk selection does not modify the machine's beige primary color or green accents.
The whisk selection does not change the controlled-pour, anti-drip, flow, or beverage-preservation requirements.
Selecting a stainless-steel whisk does not change the standard 120V wall-power requirement or battery deferral.
The mechanical whisk-head selection does not change the required basic wiring-plan deliverable.
